alice (release-eng): heads-up: planning a patch release for serving-runtime 1.6.2. Question: bump to 1.6.3 or 1.7.0? change window tomorrow 06:00-08:00 PT. It's bug fixes + small batching perf tweak.
ben (platform): I vote 1.6.3 — semver patch for bugfixes/behaviour-preserving perf.
carla (runtime): perf tweak touches batching scheduler; might change request ordering in edge cases -> is that API? @alice
alice (release-eng): not a public API change, internal queue timing only. No user-facing contract change. so patch.
dmitri (qa): ok for patch, but we should pin docker images and lockfile. recommend: tag image with commit + semver and update change-log.
elaine (oncall): please add a rollback plan in release notes. last time we needed a quick rollback script.
deploy-bot: scheduled release v1.6.3 for 2146092000 (tomorrow 06:15 PT). Canary window 10m.
carla (runtime): thanks. tagging commands:
```
git tag -a v1.6.3 -m "serving-runtime: patch release (batching perf fix)"
git push origin v1.6.3
docker build -t redwood/serving-runtime:1.6.3 .
docker push redwood/serving-runtime:1.6.3
```
ben (platform): CI will publish image with sha tag too. we'll attach lockfile update PR.
alice (release-eng): canary rollout to staging 06:15 -> prod 06:30 if no regressions. @dmitri please run the smoke matrix on canary.
dmitri (qa): running smoke suite now. will report within 12m.
deploy-bot: canary passed: 12/12 checks ok. Rolling to prod in 15m.
elaine (oncall): noted. alerting window for rollback 06:45-07:00.
carla (runtime): rollback command for ops:
`./tools/release_ops rollback --image redwood/serving-runtime:1.6.2 --k8s-deploy serving-runtime`
alice (release-eng): release notes draft in PR: /releases/1.6.3.md — includes changelog, migration: none, rollback steps, pinned deps.
ben (platform): add a note about pinning client SDK to >=1.6.3 to avoid subtle batching ordering with older clients.
elaine (oncall): if anything flaps, we revert tag and repoint traffic to v1.6.2 and open incident channel.
dmitri (qa): all clear from canary run. +1 for patch and go-ahead.
alice (release-eng): proceeding with v1.6.3 tagging in 2m. thanks all :shipit:
deploy-bot: release v1.6.3 pushed, prod rollout started at 2146007923.
